rationale: The supplied edition identifies fanqiyoṯe as “pinakiḏia (Gesangbücher)”, not Psalms. The current English substitutes a different kind of liturgical book.

summary: Clarify whether 36/44 is an additional attestation rather than the source of this quotation
rationale: The quoted Sultan/paša passage matches the supplied PrS 24/15 verse word for word after normalization. Ritter 36/44 instead describes an old man writing a sheet and giving it to a servant. The entry already cites prs 56/20, so replacing 36/44 with the automatic match would duplicate the primary source and confuse corpus numbering with page/line numbering. It remains unclear whether 36/44 was deliberately included as a separate attestation of kṯule; verify its intended role before deleting it.

summary: Move 79/7 out of the translation into the reference field
rationale: The trailing text/verse reference was absorbed into the English translation; refs is empty. Move the existing reference without changing its number. This does not claim to verify that verse, which is not supplied.

summary: Correct the dictation gloss: lektieren → diktieren
rationale: The stem is glossed “schreiben lassen, lektieren”, whereas its own Preterit translation says “er liess schreiben, diktierte” and 5/12 says “diktiert”. These identify dictation and support diktieren as the intended gloss.
